newsitem.title: USA: Brake HQ loses AutoZone contract.
newsitem.headline: Brake HQ loses AutoZone contract.

text.p: Brake Headquarters USA Inc said Monday it had lost its contract as a supplier to AutoZone Inc.

The AutoZone contract represented about 26 percent of Brake HQ's 1996 gross revenue, estimated at $35 million, Brake HQ spokesman Marc Ruskin said. Brake HQ supplied AutoZone with brake rotors, drums and hydraulics.
Ruskin said he was uncertain about the effect on earnings of the contract loss, but he said Brake HQ had new accounts that would compensate for a portion of the loss.
AutoZone said the decision to drop Brake HQ was part of its effort to consolidate vendors.
"It wasn't a performance issue so much as a need to improve the line we have right now by going to one vendor," AutoZone spokesman Eric Epperson said.
